view.title: Chief Gear
view.charmsSubline: {name} · 6 gear pieces, 3 charms each, 75 upgrade rows

shared.autoSaveHint: Every change saves at once. Steppers move one row at a time in package order.

gear.goalsHint: Goals are read only here. Set them in Plan and press Save plan.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: The package labels 150 rows with {count} tiers. A highlighted tier holds at least one of your pieces.

setBonus.title: Set bonus rules
setBonus.body: 3 pieces of the same tier give Defense and 6 pieces give Attack, for all three troop types. A piece with no level does not count. Each tier has one value.

troopType.title: Troop type is hand entered
troopType.body: Cap and Watch buff Lancer, Coat and Pants buff Infantry, Ring and Weapon buff Marksman. The package author typed this from wiki text.

capacity.title: Capacity can be Unknown
capacity.body: The first 26 rows have no deployment capacity in the package.

charms.goalsHint: Goals are read only here and are set in Plan.

secrets.title: Charm Secrets starts at level 11
secrets.body: From Level 11 Stage 1 a stage needs Charm Secrets. Earlier stages list only Charm Guide and Charm Design.

look.title: Charms change look at every level
look.body: Each charm has 18 icons, one per level. Every gear piece carries three charms, and they follow the troop type of the piece.

estimate.title: Stage scores are an estimate
estimate.body: A level score is shared evenly over the stages that lead to it. The game does not confirm the split.

summary.title: Left to reach all goals
summary.noGoals: No goals set. Set goals in Plan.
summary.openPlan: Open Plan for event points and a breakdown

setBonus.title: Set bonuses unlocked
setBonus.appliesTo: {tierName} pieces, for Infantry, Lancer and Marksman
setBonus.needs: Needs {pieces} pieces of the same tier. {stat} +0% for now.

gear.title: Plan Chief Gear
gear.description: Materials, score and power from current level to goal
gear.conversionNote: The check does not count conversions. The converter has seven exchange rates, each with a weekly limit, for example 10 Design Plans into 1 Lunar Amber up to 500 a week.

charm.title: Plan Chief Charms
charm.description: Materials, score and power from current level to goal
charm.conversionNote: The check does not count conversions: 2 Charm Guides make 1 Charm Design and back, and 40 of either make 1 Charm Secrets.

export.nothingToExport: Set a goal above a current level to export a plan.
export.powerReason: No Core Events row scores Chief Gear or Chief Charm power.

plan.inputsHint: The current level is the one on the page. Change it there. Goals are read only on the page and are set here.
